wholePhysicalScope: Named native 27-vertex outline of the main Queen Anne house and attached rear wing, oriented by the original Franklin Street centerline. The bay and porch controls are approximated within the mapped projections.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the Queen Anne turret and gables, raised Franklin porch, red brick chimney and connected guest wing. The close levels add sash, balcony rail, stair risers and carved trim.
limitations: The original mapped envelope is the horizontal control. Tower cap and roof heights, bay widths, carved patterns, rear wing façade and rear roof are approximate. The model focuses on the May 2015 exterior and attached guest wing.
The original Terrarium field is unchanged. Exterior foundation exposure, two-run stair alignment and attachment to the sidewalk are approximate. The written survey establishes eight and ten risers.
The modern color references are the exact CC0 Daderot originals. The HABS east-front image supports form and trim. Interior contents and the lot boundary are outside scope.
